implementation: The login IME regression test now enters a first character, rebuilds the auth screen, continues with a second editing update through the same simulated text-input connection, and verifies the text, focus, and IME visibility survive another app-state rebuild. This increases widget-level coverage only; it does not emulate Samsung Gboard or Android window lifecycle.

checks.name: Login IME survives continued multi-character input and rebuilds
checks.command: flutter test test/auth_screen_test.dart --plain-name "login keeps focus and entered text through app-state rebuilds"
checks.observation: The same test input connection remains visible and focused after the first character and two app-state rebuilds; the second character update is retained, and login autocorrect/suggestions stay disabled.

remaining: On the affected Samsung/Gboard device, enter multiple login characters without reopening the keyboard and verify IME visibility/focus across the real Android lifecycle.
